data.name: Create or Update Ticket Field Option
data.description:
Creates or updates an option for the given drop-down ticket field.
To update an option, include the id of the option in the custom_field_option object. Example:
{"custom_field_option": {"id": 10002, "name": "Pineapples", ... }
If an option exists for the given ID, the option will be updated. Otherwise, a new option will be created.
Response
Returns one of the following status codes:

200 with Location: /api/v2/ticket_fields/{ticket_field_id}/options.json if the ticket field option already
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates or updates an option in a Zendesk drop-down ticket field, based on the option identifier when supplied. Use it to maintain selectable field values.
Use for: add a field option, rename an option, revise option metadata
Not supported: creating ticket fields, updating tickets, managing forms

data.name: Update Ticket Form
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing Zendesk ticket form identified by its path parameter. Use it to modify form configuration as an administrator.
Use for: rename a ticket form, change form settings, revise form configuration
Not supported: creating forms, updating tickets, managing field options

data.name: Create Email for Support Ticket
data.description: Create a email with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard emails is provided.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an email object in HubSpot and returns the resulting resource, including its identifier. Use it to record email activity associated with support operations.
Use for: log a support email, create an email record, capture email properties
Not supported: sending email, creating tickets, updating contacts

data.name: Update Ticket
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates a Zendesk ticket identified by its ticket identifier. Use it to change the ticket's supplied fields.
Use for: change ticket status, assign a ticket, edit ticket details
Not supported: creating tickets, deleting tickets, managing ticket fields

data.name: Create or update a batch of tickets by unique property values
data.description: Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the idProperty query param. idProperty query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates or updates multiple HubSpot ticket records using a unique property and its values for matching. Use it for efficient batch synchronization.
Use for: batch-create tickets, batch-update tickets, upsert by unique property
Not supported: single-ticket edits, ticket deletion, ticket searches

data.name: Create
data.description: Create a ticket with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard tickets is provided.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a HubSpot ticket with supplied properties and returns the created resource, including its identifier. Use it to add a support ticket to the CRM.
Use for: create a support ticket, record ticket properties, open a CRM ticket
Not supported: updating tickets, batch upserts, deleting tickets

data.name: Update Ticket
data.description:
Using the ticket key, update the ticket. There are a few key things to note. 
1. At least one key is required in the body to update the ticket 
2. Once assigned, you cannot unset the ownerId, ticketTeamId, or ticketGroupId 
3. If a parameter is not included in the body, the field will not be updated. 



This API call is only available to organizations that have purchased Closed Loop Follow Up. Organizations not enrolled will receive a 403 with the error code
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates a Qualtrics ticket identified by its ticket key when at least one editable field is supplied. Use it to revise eligible ticket assignments or details.
Use for: edit ticket details, assign a ticket, update ticket ownership
Not supported: creating tickets, clearing protected assignments, ticket deletion
